title: Maximum Balanced Shipments
summary: Given an integer array representing the weights of parcels arranged in a straight line, select a set of non-overlapping, contiguous subarrays (shipments) such that each shipment is balanced.
statement: Given an integer array representing the weights of parcels arranged in a straight line, select a set of non-overlapping, contiguous subarrays (shipments) such that each shipment is balanced. A shipment is balanced if the weight of the last parcel in the shipment is strictly less than the maximum weight of all parcels in that shipment. Return the maximum possible number of such balanced shipments.
constraints: A shipment is a contiguous subarray whose last weight is below its maximum.
Shipments may not overlap, and parcels may be skipped.
hints: A drop below the maximum seen since the last cut is the earliest possible balanced shipment end.
Scan left to right and greedily close a shipment at every such drop.
Track the segment maximum; on value < maximum, increment the answer and reset.
Using the earliest valid end leaves the largest suffix for later shipments, so no optimal solution can gain by delaying that cut.

tests.explanation: Split as [2,5,1] and [4,3] to form two balanced shipments.
Equal final and maximum weights are not strictly balanced, so the answer is zero.
